title: P.2 Library of Functions; Mathematical Modeling

icans: I can identify the library functions and their properties.
I can find the zeros of a polynomial, their multiplicity, and the end behavior of its graph.
I can find the domain and the intercepts of a rational function.

vocab: a function f(x) = aₙxⁿ + ⋯ + a₁x + a₀ where n is a ______________ integer
the number of times a __________ (x − r) appears in a factored polynomial
a quotient of two _____________ functions, R(x) = p(x)/q(x), where q is not the zero polynomial
f(x) = ⌊x⌋, the ___________ integer less than or equal to x

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Library of functions: identity, square, cube, square root, cube root, reciprocal, and absolute value. The cube function is odd and _______________ on (−∞, ∞).
Floor function: ⌊x⌋ is the greatest integer _______________ x.
Multiplicity: if (x − r)ᵐ is a factor, the graph _______________ the x-axis at r when m is odd and touches it when m is even.

blocks.stem: f(x) = 3(x − 7)(x + 4)³. List each real zero and its multiplicity, tell whether the graph crosses or touches the x-axis there, and find the y-intercept.

notes: End behavior: for large |x|, a polynomial behaves like its _______________ term.
Rational functions: the domain is all real numbers except where the _______________ is 0.

blocks.stem: Find the domain and the intercepts of R(x) = (3x² − x)/(x² + 4).
Find the domain and the intercepts of H(x) = −4x²/((x − 2)(x + 4)).

tickets.stem: f(x) = (x − 5)²(x + 1). What does the graph do at x = 5?
